states.content: Non-emergency contact with Nadia Lopez must go only through Nadia directly (direct mobile 415-555-0191 first) and the patient portal; emergency channels may be used only in an emergency. Family is fully removed from her reminders and contact routing. The weekend check-in script will use Nadia's direct mobile only. Weekend billing notes route only to Nadia and not to family.
